reply.text:
I'm sorry you're feeling this way about your body. Skipping meals all week to lose weight is something I won't build a plan around, and I'm not going to hand you a fat burning plan on top of it. Please talk it through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can help with both the eating and how you're feeling about your body.

When you've had that conversation, I'm glad to help with the training side. Showing up and lifting is a good thing to have in your corner either way.
